patterns.description: A rain notice on the cart announces possible high demand fees. At checkout a ₹25 'High demand fee' is added (first shown at checkout) under the pre-selected 'ASAP (recommended)' delivery time. The only way to waive it is the 'Scheduled, 45–60 min' radio, which fails on the first attempt with a 'couldn't reserve a slot' message and works on the second.
